title: Noise Service Allowance by Line — Brake Service Warranties
content:
A squeal or noise complaint after a brake job is serviced free within each line's noise service period, counted in calendar days after the date of the job, up to each line's number of free noise services per warranty. The figures for Brake Service Warranties are:

| Brake service line | Noise service period, calendar days after the job date | Free noise services per warranty |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 30 | 1 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 60 | 1 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 90 | 2 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 90 | 2 |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 90 | 3 |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 30 | 1 |

**At a glance.**
- Shortest period: 30 days, on the Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty and the Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty.
- Longest period: 90 days, on the Ceramic, Premium Ceramic and Complete lines.
- Most free noise services per warranty: 3, on the Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty; the Value, Standard and Severe-Duty lines allow 1, the Ceramic and Premium Ceramic lines 2.
- The allowance is counted per warranty: each brake job on each axle has its own.
